estonia_relevance: International service relevant to Estonian SMEs using compatible existing accounts or scheduling workflows; no Estonia-specific account/runtime test performed.
jobs: Connect existing IMAP/SMTP, Gmail API or Microsoft Graph accounts; read/search/organize mail, draft/send; optional instance management
connection: Customer's HTTPS EmailEngine instance POST /mcp; explicitly enable runtime MCP setting. Access token scopes mcp and separate mcp-manage, account binding and operation permissions; optional OAuth connector sign-in.
access_and_price: 14-day trial; current advertised license €1,200 or $1,450/year excluding VAT, unlimited mailboxes; infrastructure/operations additional. Source-available rather than unrestricted free operation. IMAP/SMTP credentials or provider OAuth stay on instance.
read_write: Read-only account-bound token can list/search/read with no send/delete/write. Mail agent level permits filing/drafting/sending but not deleting. Full mail permits deletion. Management scope is separate and should not be given to ordinary inbox assistant.
limitations: Operational MCP beta/off by default; self-hosting maintenance required. No calendar support established. IMAP is mail access, SMTP sends; neither implies calendar availability. Self-hosting does not prevent selected model from receiving read mail content.
evidence_status: official public documentation inspected; not runtime-tested
brokerage_permission: unknown
notes: Strong reusable IMAP path without proprietary per-host adapter, but not necessarily simplest for one tiny company. Public docs MCP cannot read a mailbox. Exact-action human send approval remains separate from token permissions.

name: AgentMail
interface_detail: Official hosted MCP for dedicated AgentMail inboxes/calendars; not ordinary owner-mailbox synchronization
estonia_relevance: International service relevant to Estonian SMEs using compatible existing accounts or scheduling workflows; no Estonia-specific account/runtime test performed.
jobs: Create agent inboxes; read/search/draft/send/reply/forward; calendar agenda/events/invitation responses; allow/block lists
connection: https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp ; OAuth through console.agentmail.to with organization selection, or x-api-key header; compatibility bridge available
access_and_price: Free tier 3 inboxes/3,000 emails/month; Developer $20/month includes custom domains. Free addresses use agentmail.to. EU region advertised as Enterprise option. Custom domain requires DNS verification.
read_write: Send/reply/forward; draft send/delete; inbox/thread deletion; event creation/update/delete. sendInvites sends attendee invites/updates/cancellations; invitation response sends reply unless sendReply:false.
limitations: New agent mailbox, not a substitute for reading owner's Gmail/IMAP history. Google Workspace routing doc handles unrecognized addresses; existing recognized user/alias/group addresses stay with Google. Host confirmation claims are not proof server-enforced approvals.
evidence_status: official public documentation inspected; not runtime-tested
brokerage_permission: unknown
notes: Dedicated agent address/subdomain is a meaningful separate product decision. MCP includes additional agent sign-up/app-connection actions beyond mail; constrain permissions. New-mail Events are provider/client-dependent, not a universal unattended-assistant guarantee.
